note: What a server sends to end the match and say which side won. The header names no object: it carries zero.

bits.name: side100Won
bits.note: Set where side 100 won, clear where side 200 did. A client counts a win where this names its own side, and a loss otherwise.

bits.name: surrendered
bits.note: Set aside for a match ended by surrender. A client does nothing with it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

bits.name: side100Won
bits.note: Set where side 100 won, clear where side 200 did.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

revisions.note: Arriving while the match still loads, it counts as a win or loss for the player's side and the client leaves at once. Otherwise the client ends the match on its screen and sends ClientFinished, except while playing a replay.
